subject: general
question: Lakshmibai National College of Physical Education is located at ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala** is the location of the Lakshmibai National College of Physical Education.
 
• The college is named after **Rani Lakshmibai**, the queen of Jhansi, who was a key figure in the Indian Rebellion of 1857.
 
• It is one of the premier institutions in India dedicated to **physical education and sports**.
 
• The college offers various undergraduate and postgraduate programs in physical education and sports science.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The college is affiliated with the **University of Kerala** and is recognized by the **National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE)**.
 
• It has been instrumental in promoting physical education and sports in India through its various programs and initiatives.
 
• The institute also plays a significant role in the **preparation and training of athletes** for national and international competitions.
 
• Facilities at the college include state-of-the-art training centers, sports complexes, and research laboratories dedicated to sports science.
